title: Nanodrop Spectrophotometer (ND-1000) for Nucleic Acid Measurement
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.id2ca8e
materials: Blank sample (buffer or RNase free H2O)

steps.title: Initialize Nanodrop Software
steps.instruction: Open the ND-1000 V3.8.1 program on the connected computer and select the appropriate application module (e.g., Nucleic acid).

steps.title: Blank the Spectrophotometer
steps.instruction: Calibrate the machine using a blank sample such as buffer or RNase free H2O.

substeps.instruction: Open the sampling arm and load the blank sample.
Close the sampling arm to cover the sample.
Open the sampling arm and clean the upper and lower pedestals with a Kimwipe.

steps.title: Measure Nucleic Acid Sample
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration and purity of the DNA or RNA sample.

substeps.instruction: Load the DNA or RNA sample and close the sampling arm.
Select the sample type (e.g., DNA or RNA) in the upper right-hand corner of the program.
Click 'Measure' in the upper left-hand corner of the program.

steps.title: Record Data and Clean Up
steps.instruction: Collect the measurement results and prepare the machine for the next use.

substeps.instruction: Read the 260/280 ratio, 260/230 ratio, and concentration (ng/µL) measurements.
Clean the nucleic acid sample off the upper and lower pedestals with a Kimwipe.
